question: How much of L's coverage gap to G comes from slots wasted on duplicate rules (the same rule picked by several groups, A->B plus B->A, or a superset of an already chosen combination)?
practical_meaning: When several groups' display plans are merged, how many display slots are spent on the same combination twice?
rules: P5 from common.json; systems G, L and every random seed (A1 primary, S, A2)
quota: L and random systems: largest-remainder quota by each group's own Discovery basket count, ties by group id (C's rule)

V1_original.construction: each group takes its top q_g directed rules; G takes its top B (identical to C's/D's frozen lists)

V2_teammate.construction: V1 lists merged in group order 0,1,2 and de-duplicated by rule_id (first group gets the credit); then refill: among groups with candidates left, pick the group with the smallest credited-unique-rules / Discovery baskets (ties by group id) and add its next not-yet-selected directed rule; repeat until B distinct directed rules

V3_combination.unit: category combination (A->B and B->A are one slot)
V3_combination.construction_restricted: each group walks its own ranking, keeps a rule's combination only if it is neither already kept nor a superset of a kept combination, until q_g combinations; cross-group duplicates are NOT removed because they serve different customers
V3_combination.construction_shared: each group first builds its restricted V3 list; the lists are merged in group order 0,1,2, dropping a combination already in the pool or a superset of a pool combination (credit to the first group); refill as in V2 but adding combinations (skip already-present and superset combinations) until B distinct combinations
V3_combination.G: G walks its ranking with the same rule until B combinations

V4_fractional.construction: as V3 shared, except that a combination selected in the initial lists of m groups credits 1/m to each of them before refill

metrics_per_system: slots, distinct directed rules, distinct combinations, refilled slots
for L: share of its distinct combinations also in G's list of the same variant and budget
comparisons: L - G per variant/flow/budget; paired customer bootstrap interval in Validation
L position in the A1 / S / A2 distributions: median, min, max, #random >= L, empirical p
home_advantage = (L - G in Validation) - (L - G in Discovery) per variant/flow/budget

periods.discovery: build all lists; in-sample coverage only as the baseline of home_advantage
periods.validation: evaluate all variants; nothing is selected
periods.test: later single run; V1 must reproduce D's frozen Test numbers exactly (consistency check) before other variants are read

interpretation_rules.gap_mainly_duplicates: same flow and budget: |L-G| under V3 <= 0.5 * |L-G| under V1
interpretation_rules.status: E10 is a descriptive diagnostic; it is not one of the primary hypotheses
